citation: Janse van Rensburg et al. 2024. Effects of no mask, a surgical mask and a fabric buff on peripheral oxygenation saturation during moderate intensity exercise: a randomised cross-over study. Journal of Thoracic Disease
protocol: Cycling at 60% power output for 30 min with no mask, surgical mask or buff; breathing rate at resting baseline (T0) and at 9, 18 and 27 min
population: 30 participants aged 30-45 y, described as healthy in the discussion
note: Mean +/- SD by time point and mask condition. Resting posture not verified. 60% power output is a percentage of an unnamed reference (not watts).
